summary: Sound Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its earnings release for H1 2026, reporting net revenues of RMB1,690.6 million (up 25%) and net income of RMB120.5 million (up 78%). The filing is a routine financial results announcement, not a special situation. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital return events disclosed. The CEO and acting CFO commented on operational performance and AI growth strategy. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present.
